description: The modem's end-of-message marker counts against the configured transmission length: two D_PDUs that fill one block exactly go in two one-block transmissions, not one two-block transmission over the limit.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED (A-0041, A-0047); at 0 it sends S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0 to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, TTL 0 so TTD 1296000000 ms, no retransmissions, no confirmation): no SIS output (A-0095), dts.ttd starts (C-1050), and csma.lbt_wait starts with lbt_wait_dcd_ms 30000 (K-0077). The DATA C_PDU holds the DATA S_PDU SAP 5 to SAP 5 with its TTD; each type 7 has address size 3 and C_PDU ID 0, and its EOT and reception window are the half seconds from the start of its block to the end of the burst, rounded up (C-0104, C-0350, C-1043). Fixture (test data): preamble 600, flush 150, WN 2 Long blocks of 4800 ms, eom_bytes 4, so n blocks carry n x block_bytes - 4 bytes and a burst of m bytes takes ceil((m + 4) / block_bytes) blocks (corpus-format.md 5; interp C-1290). dts.max_transmission_ms 5550 allows one block (600 + 4800 + 150). 0.0.1.3 is of unknown edition, so there is no PADDING fill (C-1154), and csma.num_cont_slots 1 makes the contention wait 0 (K-0080). U_PDU "0123456789": the C_PDU is 16 bytes, cut by dts.max_segment_size 8 into two 8-byte segments (C-0527, C-0529, C-0549), D_PDUs of 32 bytes. The one block within the limit carries 64 - 4 = 60 bytes, so the first transmission at 30000 takes segment 0 and segment 1 does not fit (C-0880, C-0542): 32 + 4 bytes is one block, 5550 ms, EOT ceil(4950 / 500) = 10. Without the marker both would fit the 64-byte block and the burst would need two blocks, 10350 ms, over the limit. The unsent segment (32 bytes) needs one more transmission, so the reception window is ceil((4950 + 17850) / 500) = 46, where 17850 is 5550 + 3000 (K-0074) + 3000 (one contention slot) + 4800 (one block) + 1500 (the host allowance; interp C-1292, corpus 0.37.0, 33 before), committing to 30000 + 600 + 23000 = 53600 (C-1051, C-1052). The second transmission at 38550 (lbt_wait_vdcd_ms after the own transmission, K-0074) ends 44100, inside 53600: segment 1, offset 8, same ID and cut, EOT and window 10 (C-0350). It empties the queue, so dts.ttd is cancelled first (C-1050).
